create_get_inference_endpoint: create an InferenceEndpoint object from a raw API response dictionary with namespace and token
wait_endpoint_deployed: wait for an Inference Endpoint to reach a running state with optional timeout and polling interval
update_endpoint_config: update an Inference Endpoint's compute resources, model, or configuration settings
pause_endpoint: pause an Inference Endpoint to stop billing while preserving its configuration for later resume
get_endpoint_client: get an InferenceClient or AsyncInferenceClient to run predictions on a deployed Inference Endpoint
